label: Figure 5.3: The supply of kayaks and paddleboards
alt: Two diagrams: a movement up along the kayak supply curve as price rises from P to P1, and a leftward shift of the paddleboard supply curve from S to S1 at an unchanged price.
caption: Left: when the price of kayaks rises from P to P<sub>1</sub>, there is a movement along the supply curve S and quantity supplied rises from Q to Q<sub>1</sub>. Right: as boat-builders move their materials and workers into kayaks, the supply of paddleboards shifts left from S to S<sub>1</sub>, so less is supplied at the same price P.
